title: Emotion Network Analysis During COVID-19 Quarantine - A Longitudinal Study
limitations: - Did not perform group classification based on gender, work status, presence of more people at home, history of mental health problems, and personality characteristics; - Data not readily available for public use; - High attrition when comparing baseline and longitudinal data; - Dimension structure of the POMS could have influenced clustering in the networks.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated as publicly available, but the authors provide contact information for data access. The study used R packages mIVAR and qgraph for network estimation and visualization.
